title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.0 (Peaked September 20, 2026 at 18:10 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 365 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Things are pretty calm. 🌎

A broad southern-central coronal hole is the Sun’s main visual feature today, while sunspot activity remains sparse.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
